_comment: Hand-authored. Bank 7: hit tests and damage ($D229-$D440). The generators subtract these.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the hit box (`$D229`, slots `$C0B1`, `$C0B4`, `$C0B7`)
regions.description: Object X's box from its metasprite (`$0548`; entry `$D22C` takes the metasprite in A, `$D230` the y centre in A): **y max `$0728` = y + `$C201[meta]` (capped `$FF`), y min `$0710` = y - `$C201[meta]` (floor 0), x max `$06F8` = x + `$C174[meta]`, x min `$06E0` = x - `$C174[meta]`**: half-heights and half-widths looked up by metasprite id.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the box with a y offset (`$D266`, slot `$C0BA`)
regions.description: As `$D230` with y = A + `$0518` (0 on carry).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): box, then the test with mask 4 (`$D276`, slot `$C0BD`)
regions.description: `JSR $D229` and on into `$D279`.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): test against the player side, mask 4 (`$D279`, slot `$C0C0`)
regions.description: `LDA #4 / JSR $D348`; carry = hit (`$D2AA`).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): test against the ship only (`$D281`, slot `$C0C3`)
regions.description: Box, then `$D364` on slot 0 if its type is `$81` (the ship in play): carry = hit.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): box, then mask `$30` (`$D294`, slot `$C0C6`)
regions.description: `JSR $D229` and on into `$D297`.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): test, mask `$30` (`$D297`, slot `$C0C9`)
regions.description: `LDA #$30 / JSR $D348`: the ordinary enemy's test (player shots and the ship). Carry = hit.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): box, then mask `$20` (`$D29F`, slot `$C0CF`)
regions.description: The fixed targets' test: only objects whose collision flags have bit 5 (the gun shots, not the A weapons or the ship).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): record the hit
regions.description: `$6E` := the slot hit (Y), `$6D` := its type, `$6C` := the tested object's type (both AND `$7F`).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the consequences (`$D2BB`, slot `$C0D2`)
regions.description: No hit (carry clear) goes to the death check `$D32A`. A hit plays sound `$20` and goes on at `$D2C7`; `$D2C5` (slot `$C0D5`) is the entry without the sound.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): who was hit?
regions.description: Y := `$6E`; **a shot or another object (non-zero) goes to `$D30E`, the ship (0) goes on**.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the ship: is the life meter still running?
regions.description: `$48` (life) differs from `$49` (shown): skip the damage (the ship is already being hurt) and just flash.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the ship: the hit
regions.description: `$05A8,X` (the enemy's attack) zero does nothing; otherwise sound `$38`.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the ship: damage = attack / shield
regions.description: `JSR $F9AE`: the enemy's attack divided by the ship's `$0590` (its shield value); **at least 1**.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): life -= damage
regions.description: `$48` - damage; a result below 0 goes to `$D2EF`.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): life ran out
regions.description: If the shown life `$49` is non-zero just set `$48` := 0; if it is also 0 **the ship's type becomes `$D442` = 4 (dying)**. (The meter has to run down before the ship dies.)

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): store the life
HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the hit flash
regions.description: Slot 0's flags `$0578` |= `$C0` and `$0788` := 15 (the player's handler blinks for 15 frames).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): then the enemy
regions.description: Y := 0 (the ship's attack is `$05A8`); on into the enemy's side.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): a shot hit: its side
regions.description: The other object's hit points `$0590,Y` -= X's attack `$05A8,X` (floor 0).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the enemy's side
regions.description: X's hit points -= Y's attack (floor 0).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): death check
regions.description: X's hit points non-zero: return. Zero: **`$0740,X` := X's type (remembered) and the type := `$D441[type]`**, the death type (8 an explosion, 7 the big one, `$30` a block blast, `$B1`/`$B2` the item boxes, 4 the ship, `$0A` a spark).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): set the backdrop (`$D33F`, slot `$C0CC`)
regions.description: `$0180` := A and `$017F` := 3 (upload both palettes).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): scan the player side (`$D348`)
regions.description: `$6F` := the mask; slots 4 down to 0: **a slot counts if its type has bit 7 (initialised), its flags `$0578` bit 7 is clear (not in its hit flash) and flags AND mask is non-zero**, then `JSR $D364` against it; the first overlap returns with carry set and Y = the slot; none: carry clear.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): do two boxes overlap? (`$D364`)
regions.description: The four comparisons of object X's box with slot Y's (`$06F8`, `$06E0`, `$0728`, `$0710`): any separation returns carry clear, otherwise carry set.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): hit points x 16 (`$D385`, slot `$C165`)
regions.description: `$0590,X` shifted left four times, the overflow into `$0740,X`: **a 12-bit hit-point count, low byte `$0590`, high part `$0740`**.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the consequences with the boss rules (`$D39B`, slot `$C0D8`)
regions.description: No hit returns. The ship (slot 0): its attack `$05A8` is saved and made 0 so touching the boss costs the boss nothing; the boss's attack still hurts the ship.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): a shot on a boss: how often
regions.description: A gun shot (slot <= `$3B`) always counts; the A weapons' objects only on every 8th frame (`$41 AND 7`).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): a shot on a boss: its attack
regions.description: Sound `$39`; the shot's attack is capped at 5 for this exchange (restored afterwards).

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): a boss: the exchange
regions.description: The high part of the hit points is saved in `$15`, the exchange runs (`$D2C7`), and the shot's attack is put back.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): a boss: borrow from the high part
regions.description: If the low byte reached 0 but the high part is not: **high part - 1, low byte := `$FF`, the type restored (the death transition is undone) and the high part stored.** The 12-bit count is thus a real counter.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): a boss: what becomes of the shot
regions.description: A gun shot goes to `$D413`; an A weapon's object makes its spark at the middle of its own box (`$06E0/$06F8`, `$0710/$0728`), except weapon 9 (the Hyper Laser), whose spark is at its object position (`$D41D`), and is itself left in place.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): a gun shot turns into a countdown
regions.description: Flags := `$19`, type := 9 (the invisible countdown); the spark is made at its position (`$D41D`). RUN: the shot was type 9 with flags 25, 24, 23 on three frames.

regions.name: HIT TESTS AND DAMAGE (bank 7 `$D229-$D440`): the spark
regions.description: A free slot (`$FA5B`) gets a type-8 explosion at the shot's place with `$0740` := 0 (a silent small burst).
